pages.title: Move the Build Area
pages.text: Use the $(l)X / Y / Z offset$() steppers in the printer GUI. They shift the build area relative to its default position (centered directly above the printer).$(br2)Each axis is capped at $(l)±32$() blocks, enough to place a build beside or above the machine without printing into the printer itself.

pages.title: Rotate the Build
pages.text: The $(l)Rotate$() button below the offsets spins the whole print $(l)90° clockwise$() per tap (0 → 90 → 180 → 270 → 0). Everything turns with it: a north-facing door or stairway comes out facing east.$(br2)Rotation pivots around the build's center, so it stays put and your X/Y/Z offsets are never touched. The $(l)Ghost$() preview updates live, so you can line it up before you print.
